extracted.name: Brown Sugar Chicken Brine
extracted.description: Brown sugar, garlic, soy sauce, and molasses add sweet and savory notes to this quick and easy recipe for a make-ahead chicken brine.
instruction_lines: Mix salt, brown sugar, garlic, and cayenne pepper together in a large bowl. Pour in water; stir until dissolved. Mix in molasses and soy sauce. Let stand until brine comes to room temperature, about 50 minutes.
